main.description: Private Catbird surface (blue.catbird.labyrinth.*), not an ATProto or community-ratified lexicon. The log of recovery-share activity for the caller's DID, oldest first: stores, verify reads, restore fetches, refused fetches, deletions and account purges, each with the acting chat device where known. Active devices poll it to tell the user when a recovery code or passkey was used to fetch a share. Mailbox endpoint on the caller's home DS. Requires an active, non-revoked chat device of the caller DID, proven by the account-bound service JWT and a signed device request. A pending chat device may not store, delete or list shares; the clean-slate service has no Labyrinth-device binding table. Common errors: NotAuthorized, AccountSessionExpired, DeviceRevoked, RateLimited, InvalidRequest, PayloadTooLarge.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor; returns events after it. Omit to start from the oldest retained event.
Opaque cursor for the next page; also the resume point for later polls.

event.description: Private Catbird surface (blue.catbird.labyrinth.*), not an ATProto or community-ratified lexicon. One recovery-share event.

vdeviceId.description: Recovery bundle (virtual device) id: the 16-byte vid derived from the recovery code, equal to the bundle's record key in hex.

actorDeviceId.description: Chat device that made the call, when known.
